_comment: Canonical hook policy and binding registry. Generated views must be refreshed with python3 lib/hooks_registry.py generate.

policy.context-gate-hook-py.purpose: dependency-guardian, destructive-git, secrets, env-protection, ssh-block, deploy-gate, context-gate

policy.continuity-push-recorder-py.purpose: PreToolUse record-only recorder (Bash). Before a `git push` runs, pre-registers the level-with-main premise on the signed Congruent Continuity chain with a deterministic probe falsifier and the session's transcript path, so post-hoc settlement grows a PAIRED corpus. Never blocks, steers or prints; audits to logs/continuity-recorder.jsonl. Rule: rules/congruent-continuity.md (D3: WARN-only until precision is measured).

policy.dispatch-brief-hook-py.purpose: PreToolUse on Agent|Task: appends the task brief (the GRIP rules the subagent type needs and cannot load natively, lib/dispatch_brief.py) to the launch's prompt through updatedInput, copying every other field and taking no permission decision. The only updatedInput writer on Agent and Task (KERN v2 ruling 3). Never blocks; an empty brief prints nothing; every fault exits 0. It holds what it gave a launch until --commit on PostToolUse (which fires only when the launch ran) records it, and --renew on PreCompact clears the session's once-per-type record. Audits to logs/dispatch-brief-hook.jsonl.

policy.fanout-preflight-gate-py.purpose: Refuses (permissionDecision deny) an Agent/Task launch when the DECLARED plan tier is pro (GRIP_TIER or the tier config; never auto-detected) and the session's predicted fan-out, launches x 250,000 tokens, is over the pro line of one agent. Overrides: a one-shot marker for that session, state/session/fanout-override-<key>, which the refusal names (deleted on use, stale after 10 minutes), or GRIP_FANOUT_OVERRIDE=1. On max, api or an undeclared tier it only warns (additionalContext, one systemMessage per session). Fails open on its own errors (operator decision, HITL 2026-10-15).

policy.grip-browser-result-shield-py.purpose: Redacts every mcp__grip-browser__* tool result through lib/redaction_shield.py (llm_egress) before the model sees it, via PostToolUse updatedMCPToolOutput (measured on Claude Code 2.1.301, docs/measurements/2026-10-18-claude-code-hook-rewrite-mcp.md); withholds the result when the shield cannot run.

policy.grip-browser-tool-policy-gate-py.purpose: Capability lock for the grip-browser MCP server (stealth-browser-mcp, attached per launch via mcp-servers/grip-browser/mcp.json): classifies every mcp__grip-browser__* call by effect (lib/grip_browser_tool_policy.py). Observe tools and ephemeral-mode interaction pass; credential, code-exec and host-file tools need their GRIP_BROWSER_ALLOW_* switch; server-admin and unknown tools are denied; spawn_browser, navigate and every path argument are pinned.

policy.guardrail-evasion-gate-py.purpose: DENY a Write/Edit that obfuscates code to evade a safety scanner (rules/no-guardrail-evasion.md)

policy.guardrail-removal-merge-gate-py.purpose: DENY `gh pr merge` when the PR removes guardrail enforcement primitives (rules/agent-dispatch-protocol.md L5)

policy.main-tier-inject-py.purpose: SessionStart main-session tier (KERN v2, the operator's ruling of 2026-10-18): prints chunk K (--chunk 0 to 5, one binding each) of the rules config/rules-scope.json lists under main_tier, packed by lib/main_tier.py under the 10,000-character additionalContext cap. Prints nothing for an empty chunk; fail-open on any error.

policy.measured-claim-gate-py.purpose: DENY a git commit / gh pr create|edit|comment|close whose text claims a test count ("12 passed") that no test-runner summary line in the session transcript reports; WARN when the session holds no summary; GRIP_MEASURED_CLAIM_GATE=0 on the command overrides, logged. Unless that check already denies: also DENY a git commit -F / gh pr or issue create|edit|comment --body-file whose named file still lacks the change of an Edit, Write or MultiEdit that failed in this turn (GRIP#9394); GRIP_STALE_POST_GATE=0 overrides, logged; this second DENY outranks the first check's own WARN. Fails open on its own errors, like guardrail-evasion-gate.py (rules/measured-claims-read-the-output-first.md).

policy.merged-branch-guard-py.purpose: WARN when a git commit lands on a branch whose PR already merged. Squash merges make ancestry checks blind, so detection uses the forge record (state MERGED plus mergedAt). Fails open on any gh error.

policy.model-pin-guard-py.purpose: Keeps this machine's default Claude Code model when the /model picker saves a pick into the shared settings.json: deletes the saved `model` key, re-asserts env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL from config/model-pin.local.json, logs the revert and sends a terminal notice. Never blocks; no pin file means no action.

policy.model-switch-guard-py.purpose: model-switch-guard: warn (deny/ask via GRIP_MODEL_SWITCH_GUARD) on a switch to a sub-1M or uncatalogued model, ledger every switch, tell Claude its new window

policy.next-step-recorder-py.purpose: Stop-event consumer of the RECOMMENDED NEXT STEP token. Records a (yours) step to the cross-session pending store so the operator can answer it from any shim, and brakes a (mine) continuation chain on stall, on the operator's own declared AFK window, and on an outer cap that backstops a lying progress probe. Fail-open on every path.

policy.operator-close-hook-py.purpose: Stop-event advisory. Flags a response that tells the operator to sleep or rest, infers his state from the clock, or declares the session over on his behalf. Never blocks; emits hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext and audits to logs/operator-close-hook.jsonl. Rule: rules/never-close-on-the-operators-behalf.md

policy.pool-a-offload-advisory-py.purpose: Advise a Pro-tier session (lib/grip_tier.py envelope route_heavy_to_hal) once per session per kind that an Agent/Task spawn or a `claude -p`/`claude --print` Bash child could run on HAL's Pool B instead, at no Claude cost; never denies (rules/pool-a-offload-routing.md).

policy.prompt-routing-hook-py.purpose: On UserPromptSubmit, exempt prompts return in-process; any other prompt goes on stdin to a detached worker (hooks/prompt-routing-worker.py) that writes the router's assessment to state/routing/last-assessment.json. After writing it, the worker makes one HAL decide call (TypeSafe's Jev) for a shadow Score over the four patterns only when GRIP_PROMPT_ROUTING_SCORE is 1 (off by default since 2026-10-17, H806 refuted) and the prompt is not kept home (long, pasted, personal words, or refused by the decision-model privacy floor), and logs it to logs/prompt-routing-shadow.jsonl without the prompt (lib/prompt_routing_score.py, the Jev plan's Phase 2b.3). The hook itself makes no network call and never blocks.

policy.rea-tool-policy-gate-py.purpose: Capability lock for the REA reverse-engineering MCP server attached via .mcp.json: denies mcp__rea__* runtime tools (capture_*, observe_*, extract_*) unless GRIP_REA_ALLOW_RUNTIME=1, denies unclassified tools, passes the 127 inspection tools.

policy.shared-tree-write-advisory-py.purpose: PreToolUse Edit|Write advisory. Says so when a session working outside the shared tree (~/.claude, a symlink onto ~/.grip, which launchd agents execute from) writes into it; feature work belongs in a worktree. Never blocks and takes no permission decision: emits hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext plus a one-line systemMessage, and audits to logs/shared-tree-write-advisory.jsonl. Rule: rules/shared-tree-is-not-canonical.md, mandate 3

policy.spend-watchdog-hook-py.purpose: UserPromptSubmit advisory: print at most one line naming an in-flight Workflow run with no result for 30+ minutes and 3+ api-request entries per agent across the stall, or this session spending 5M+ tokens / moving the weekly figure 0.05+ in the last hour; never blocks (rules/fan-out-spends-the-weekly-limit.md)

policy.ste-lint-hook-py.purpose: Advisory measurement on two events. On Stop it scores the turn against Simplified Technical English (lib/ste_lint.py), appends one row of numbers to logs/ste-lint-hook.jsonl and shows the operator one line (top-level systemMessage, which costs no model turn). On UserPromptSubmit it hands that line to the model once, only when GRIP_STE_FEEDBACK=1. It never refuses, exits 0 on every path, opens no connection and starts no process. GRIP_STE_VISIBLE=0 silences the line.

policy.teach-once-gate-py.purpose: KERN v2 teach-once gate (GRIP#6658, ruling 1(a)). PreToolUse Bash: refuses (permissionDecision deny) the FIRST command in a recipient context (the session, or one subagent) that triggers a command-moment rule (git commit / gh pr create|edit -> rules/commit-standards.md; codex or grip-codex-ladder -> rules/gpt-on-the-subscription-never-credits.md; gh with no -R/--repo and no GH_REPO -> rules/gh-repo-resolution.md), with the rule's full text as the reason; the command, run again, passes. Once per context and rule version (sha256 of the text), recorded in state/teach-once/<session_id>.json BEFORE the refusal, and no refusal when that record cannot be written (Invariant 1). PreCompact with --renew forgets the session's lessons. Fails open on its own errors; audits to logs/teach-once-gate.jsonl without the command text (lib/teach_once.py).

policy.workflow-budget-gate-py.purpose: DENY a Workflow-tool launch with no declared GRIP_MAX_AGENTS cap, a cap over 48, or weekly/five-hour Claude utilisation already past 70%/85%; WARN past 50% weekly or on schema-only agent() calls with no lightweight agentType (rules/fan-out-spends-the-weekly-limit.md)

policy.red-check-merge-gate-py.purpose: DENY `gh pr merge` while a GitHub Actions job on the PR's head is red and its base branch's newest finished reading of that job is not, or while a run on the head has not finished (lib/red_check.py, the merge sweep's own rules, GRIP#8343 and GRIP#8682; fails open, GRIP_RED_CHECK_GATE=0 overrides and is logged)

policy.full-prose-marker-hook-py.purpose: Keeps the operator's normal mode through a compaction (lib/full_prose_marker.py)

policy.untrusted-egress-gate-py.purpose: After raw web text entered the turn (WebFetch, WebSearch, a browser page, a fetch to a public address, a gh read of another owner's repository, or a read of a fetched file), note every Bash send in Claude's context and record whether it would be held; under GRIP_EGRESS_GATE=hold, DENY a send outside the trusted owners until the operator's next message (GRIP#8959; fails open)

policy.plan-archive-hook-py.purpose: PreToolUse Write advisory. Copies a Claude Code plan to <plans>/archive/ before a Write replaces it, so a plan a Write replaces is never lost (an Edit or a shell overwrite is not watched); only the configured plans folder counts (GRIP_PLANS_DIR, else CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/plans, else ~/.claude/plans). Never blocks and takes no permission decision: emits hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext plus a systemMessage naming the copy, and audits each copy and each failed copy to logs/plan-archive-hook.jsonl. Module: lib/plan_archive.py

MCP elicitation response secrets scanning and blocking
Grants destructive approvals from the operator's ANSWER. Without it no approval is ever granted (fail-safe), and before #4809 the PreToolUse path granted them from the question text alone.
Unified real-time next_up Hook Push (rate-limited, fail-open, async)
GRIP-first retrieval gate for Agent calls
Advisory memory check before HAL server/council invocations — async, never blocks
